newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 1.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South
Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not
checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Hyundai Motor, Daewoo Motor and Kia Motors agreed in principle to form a consortium to run Kia Steel Co. The three carmakers would have equal stakes in the consortium.
- Eight U.S. Congressmen will visit North Korea next week to meet with Pyongyang's ranking government officials.
- Korea and Japan agreed to improve bilateral economic cooperation as the two countries pledged to work harder to ensure that trade and other issues of common interest are properly addressed.
- Seoul and Beijing have decided to seek a "provisional" settlement of fishing issues before the conclusion of negotiations to set the maritime boundaries of their Exclusive Economic Zones.
